approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce an answered due date that borrows an issued date from the same exact citation.
Bind only explicit date-role phrases immediately associated with an explicit full date.
Cover common due, issued, submitted, received, sent, reviewed, approved, revision and response labels across RFI, Submittal and Email text.
Make no provider request, dependency, migration, date arithmetic, chronology inference or source-authority rule.
title: Keep project-answer date roles grounded
objective: Reject a labeled date claim that cites another date role from the same passage while preserving unlabeled and formatting-equivalent dates.
